items.headline: Road Kill XC 2026 canceled over low registration
items.summary: Trail Racing Over Texas canceled the Sept. 19 Road Kill XC at Bear Creek after low registration. Registered runners are being emailed refund options, and club entry vouchers are set for automatic refunds.

items.headline: HARRA Fall Runner of the Season continues after Road Kill cancelation
items.summary: HARRA's Fall Runner of the Season still runs through Space City 10 Miler, UTHealth Houston Half, Houston 25K, Coach Andy 30K, and the Chevron Houston Marathon. The Sept. 19 Road Kill XC opener was canceled by TROT for low registration.

items.headline: Komen Houston Race for the Cure returns Oct. 3 at Sam Houston Park
items.summary: The 2026 Komen Houston Race for the Cure 5K is Saturday, Oct. 3 at Sam Houston Park, with a competitive 5K start at 8 a.m. after the survivor parade and opening ceremonies. Packet pickup is planned at Dick's Sporting Goods on Post Oak.

items.headline: 41st Houston Heights Fun Run set for Oct. 10 at Marmion Park
items.summary: The Houston Heights Association's 41st annual Fun Run is Saturday, Oct. 10 at Marmion Park on Heights Boulevard. The 5K and 10K are USATF-certified flat courses, with a kids' 1K and 5K walk options.

items.headline: Golden Harvest Half returns Sept. 26 at Brazos River Park
items.summary: Bodies Race Company's Golden Harvest Half Marathon, 5K, and 10K are Saturday, Sept. 26 at Brazos River Park in Sugar Land. The morning includes a kids' dash, chip timing, and post-race snacks at the finish.

items.headline: Walt Cunningham Angels' Race for Space set for Oct. 24 at Space Center Houston
items.summary: The fourth annual Walt Cunningham Angels' Race for Space is Saturday, Oct. 24 at Space Center Houston, with timed and untimed 5K and 10K options plus a family fun run. Proceeds support Be An Angel programs for children with special needs.

items.headline: Day of the Dead Half Marathon heads to Kingdom Builders Center on Oct. 17
items.summary: Bigfoot Running Company's Day of the Dead Half Marathon is Saturday, Oct. 17 at Kingdom Builders Center in Houston, with half, quarter marathon, 5K, and 1-mile options. The morning includes a kids' dash and a costume contest before the start.

items.headline: LifeGift 2nd Chance Run moves to Willow Waterhole on Sept 19
items.summary: LifeGift's Houston 2nd Chance Run returns Saturday, September 19 at Willow Waterhole Greenway (new venue), with a 5K and 1-mile walk/run honoring organ, eye, and tissue donors and raising awareness for Texans waiting for transplant.

items.headline: Tunnel to Towers 5K returns to Cypress for a fifth year
items.summary: The Tunnel to Towers 5K Run & Walk – Cypress / Northwest Houston is Saturday, September 19 at John Paul Landing Park's Environmental Education Center, honoring first responders and military heroes. Registration remains open; race-morning check-in starts at 7 a.m.

items.headline: 2027 Houston Marathon Training Kick Off set for October 6
items.summary: A free community Training Kick Off for the Chevron Houston Marathon, Aramco Houston Half Marathon, and We Are Houston 5K is Tuesday, October 6 from 6–8 p.m. at the Roy H. Cullen Timing Track in Memorial Park.

items.headline: Houston 9/11 Heroes Run marks 25th anniversary at City Hall
items.summary: The 2026 Houston 9/11 Heroes Run 5K gathered runners, ruckers, and walkers on Sept. 12 at Houston City Hall for the 25th anniversary of 9/11. Packet pickup was at the Houston Police Officers Union before race day.

items.headline: Bundle and save on HARRA Warm-Up Series races
items.summary: Register for multiple Warm-Up Series races together before Sep 20 and save: Space City 10 Miler, UTHealth Houston Half, Houston 25K, and Coach Andy 30K (or half marathon track) at discounted bundle pricing.

items.headline: Space City 10 Miler returns October 11
items.summary: The HARRA Fall Series race features a certified 10-mile course plus 5K and two-person relay at UH Clear Lake. Registration is open with pricing increasing after Aug 31. Cash awards for top finishers in the 10-miler.

items.headline: Alex's 5K set for November 7 at Avondale House
items.summary: The 16th annual Alex's 5K Run/Walk & Kids' K benefits autism charities. The Power In Motion fall goal race takes place Nov 7 with 5K starting at 8:30 a.m. and Kids' K at 8:00 a.m. Early bird pricing ends Aug 31.

items.headline: Memorial Hermann 10 for Texas set for Oct. 10 in The Woodlands
items.summary: The Woodlands Township previewed the Memorial Hermann 10 for Texas on Oct. 10 at Northshore Park, with the USATF-sanctioned 10-mile, Armadillo Run 5K, and One 4 Texas kids' run. Fields are capped and there is no race-day registration.

items.headline: Power In Motion Fall 2026 kicks off September 2
items.summary: HARRA's 10-week 5K clinic for beginning and intermediate runners started Sep 2 at Memorial Park Fitness Center, wraps Nov 4, with Alex's 5K on Nov 7 as the goal race. Registration open through mid-September.

items.headline: UTHealth Houston Half Marathon & 10K slated for October 25
items.summary: The Houston Striders' signature race features a flat downtown course with half marathon and 10K distances. Early bird registration is open. The nonprofit event has donated over $1 million to Houston charities since 1985.

items.headline: HARRA Party in the Park brings together Houston runners
items.summary: Free community celebration took place Aug 8 at Memorial Park with refreshments, live music, club tents, and prize giveaways. The annual event marks the start of fall training season and highlights Houston's running clubs.

items.headline: 2027 Chevron Houston Marathon and Aramco Half sell out
items.summary: Organizers told ABC13 on Aug. 4 that general registration for the Jan. 17, 2027 Chevron Houston Marathon and Aramco Houston Half is sold out, the fastest sellout since the pandemic. A few Run for a Reason charity marathon entries remained through the HERO program.

items.headline: HARRA offers student memberships for $15
items.summary: Students in good standing at high school, college, or graduate institutions can join HARRA for just $15 plus processing. Email student ID to treasurer@harra.org to confirm eligibility and access member benefits.

items.headline: HARRA 2026-2027 membership year now open
items.summary: The new HARRA fiscal year began July 1. Join or renew now for benefits including race discounts, Runner of the Season eligibility, free community events (Party in the Park, Tour de Bayou XC), and Power In Motion clinic pricing.

items.headline: HARRA Spring 2026 Runner of the Season standings finalized
items.summary: HARRA posted final Spring 2026 Runner of the Season standings. Top finishers in each age division can earn cash awards if they completed at least three series races, with prizes of $95 to $120 for the top three.

items.headline: Zouhair Talbi wins Chevron Houston Marathon in course-record 2:05:45
items.summary: Zouhair Talbi became the first American man to win the Chevron Houston Marathon since 2002, finishing in a course-record 2:05:45 on Jan. 11. Calli Hauger-Thackery won the women's race in 2:24:17.

items.headline: Habtom Samuel sets Aramco Houston Half course record in 59:01
items.summary: Eritrea's Habtom Samuel won the 2026 Aramco Houston Half Marathon in a course-record 59:01 in his first half and first road race. Fantaye Belayneh of Ethiopia won the women's half.

items.headline: Chron guide: road closures and parking for 2026 Houston Marathon weekend
items.summary: The Houston Chronicle laid out downtown road closures, parking tips, and METRO notes ahead of the Jan. 2026 Chevron Houston Marathon and Aramco Half weekend. Start-line streets began closing early Sunday morning.

items.headline: Houston renews Runner Friendly Community designation
items.summary: The Road Runners Club of America renewed Houston's Runner Friendly Community status in 2024, valid through 2029. The designation recognizes cities with strong running infrastructure, community support, and governmental advocacy.
